messages:
nora: Quick shout — facilities restocked the kombucha and emergency chia pudding. Saved my demo. Big thanks @jamie! :sparkles:
jamie: oh wow you survived the demo? :sweat_smile: glad it helped. team snack budget approves.
alex: Huge thanks to the snack sherpas. Also can we settle a VERY IMPORTANT poll: boba run — milk tea with tapioca vs fruit tea with popping boba? Vote 🍵🧋
maria: milk tea all the way. tapioca forever. :heart_eyes:
sam: fruit tea maybe? but tapioca slaps. :shrug:
ops-bot: Poll created: /poll "Boba?" "Milk tea (tapioca)" "Fruit tea (popping boba)" ends in 24h — react :one: or :two:
nora: added a bonus: whoever braves the line gets a sticker pack. @maria you in? :grin:
jamie: can confirm facilities will reimburse up to $20 per person on receipts. don't go broke pls :money_with_wings:
alex: also shoutout to @sam for staying late on infra during the demo — sandwich + kombucha courtesy of snack fund :sandwich:
sam: haha cheers! no need to make it official but ty :)
maria: voted :one: — milk tea. thanks @jamie for the reimburse.
nora: here's a victory gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheers-teamwork-3o6MbdN1vQ3dXQZkXK :tada:
jamie: winner winner boba dinner? we'll tally tomorrow. :ballot_box_with_ballot:
